newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Yellen to meet on U.S. GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Yellen to meet on U.S. GDP data.

text.p: President Clinton and Council of Economic Advisers chairwoman Janet Yellen are to meet Thursday to review second-quarter U.S. economic growth figures, White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
The figures showed a moderation in growth of gross domestic product to a 2.2 percent annual rate in the April-June quarter, down from a revised 4.9 percent pace in the first quarter.
McCurry said the growth figures were "strong." The figures for the first six months of the year reflected a combined growth rate of 3.5 percent, "which is great," he said.
